conclusions_for_ladder: Seven of the ten researched fixtures are priceable by the Valve model rung the moment they enter the ladder (1079201, 1079202, 1081160, 1081162, 1081163, 1081164, 1093218): every involved team has a unique complete five-player row in the 2026-10-05 standings under the exact Hotspawn name.
Three fixtures stay model-blocked: 1079203 (BRUTE double row), 1081159 (no LFO 10 row), 1082792 (The Huns double row).

1082792 now has a bindable Polymarket series book (spread 0.10) whose only strict-join blocker is the outcome name 'The Huns Esports'; a reviewed registry alias already exists but the market path does not consult the registry.

The 3-6 hour Hotspawn-vs-Polymarket/bo3.gg start-time conflicts on 1079202/1079203/1093218 are a data-quality decision for the ladder owner: either widen the market-path time tolerance, reconcile against bo3.gg/HLTV times, or treat Hotspawn's times as authoritative and accept the missed markets.

No esportsbook line exists for any of the ten fixtures at read time; HLTV rankings are the only HLTV-first evidence available for the model-blocked ones, and they are recorded as qualitative guidance only, never as probabilities.
limitations: Raw response bodies were read through Arena's page-fetch tool and transcribed verbatim; they were not byte-archived, so SHA-256 integrity hashes cover only the Valve standings file (fetched in full through the GitHub contents API).

Polymarket series-level books were read in full for 1079203 and 1082792 only; for 1079201, 1079202 and 1093218 the Map 1 child books are recorded and the series market's existence is noted without its quote.
The HLTV team ranking edition read is 2026-10-19 (the 2026-10-26 edition returned 404 at 00:55Z); HLTV VRS-mirror numbers are labelled 2026/october/26 on the pages themselves.
Thunderpick's prematch API could not be queried directly (POST-only endpoint; the fetch tool performs GET only); the bo3.gg bet_updates relay is the observed Thunderpick surface.
Crowd figures ('% picked' on Hotspawn, HLTV 'Pick a winner' fan votes) are recorded for completeness and are explicitly NOT probabilities; none may be used as probability inputs.
